# grep (v0) — Claude baseline package

Clean v0-only package for the Claude-only baseline. Human-written tests and other versions (v1–v5, seeded) are not included.

## Layout

```
grep/
├── inputs/                              Sample input files for searching
├── source/                              Run tests from here (paths like ../inputs/...)
└── versions.alt/versions.orig/v0/       v0 source (grep.c, headers, makefile)
```

## Build

```bash
cd versions.alt/versions.orig/v0
make build COMPILE_PARAMETERS='-std=gnu89 -Wno-implicit-int -Wno-implicit-function-declaration'
```

Many compiler warnings are normal. Success means the build prints `done` and `grep.exe` exists.

**Mac:** If macOS blocks the binary after download, from the package root run `xattr -cr .` first.

**Windows:** Use WSL (Ubuntu), then the same build command.

## Quick run check

```bash
cd versions.alt/versions.orig/v0
echo hello world! | ./grep.exe hello
```

Expected output: `hello world!`

Example using an input file (run from `source/`):

```bash
cd source
../versions.alt/versions.orig/v0/grep.exe -n I ../inputs/grep1.dat
../scripts:
